    Crown-free factorization orders #

    Formalize the finite-poset content of BGRS 8.5. Excluding the four-element crown makes every bounded pair admit a supremum. Excluding the six-element crown forces the three pairwise suprema of three incomparable elements into one of the three configurations obtained from Figures 57--59 by permutation. Figure 60 is recorded separately as the case in which only the two adjacent suprema exist.
